_about: Each run reads the boxes named in 'sources', checks every message
against 'keep' first, then 'rules' top to bottom. First match wins.
No match = the message stays where it is.
A rule matches when ANY 'from' entry matches the sender (exact address,
or '@domain' for the whole domain and its subdomains) AND, if 'subject'
is given, ANY subject pattern matches (Python regex, case-insensitive).
A rule with only 'subject' matches any sender. 'only_from_box' limits a
rule to messages found in that box.
